company.name: Formal
company.shortDescription: Formal is a SaaS technology startup that builds operating system for data of the modern company.
company.description: Formal is a venture-backed startup building the operating system for data of the modern company. Formal is a SaaS technology startup founded in July 2021 which launched its SaaS product in Dec 2021.

productsAndServices.description: A system that dynamically learns data flows, classifies data, and recommends and enforces least-privilege access policies in real time.
productsAndServices.name: Formal Data Graph

productsAndServices.description: A reverse-proxy deployed in the customer’s VPC that monitors and controls data access to datastores and APIs without being in the data flow.
productsAndServices.name: Formal Proxy (Protocol-aware Reverse-Proxy)

productsAndServices.description: An API-first, code-driven approach to integrate Formal’s data security controls into infrastructure as code workflows using Terraform, Pulumi, TypeScript, and Python.
productsAndServices.name: Data Security as Code

productsAndServices.description: Techniques to dynamically mask or filter sensitive data in real time based on access policies to limit data exposure.
productsAndServices.name: Dynamic Data Masking and Filtering

productsAndServices.description: A suite of access control mechanisms including role-based and attribute-based access control, multi-factor authentication, device trust, and secret-less authentication.
productsAndServices.name: Access Control Features (RBAC/ABAC, MFA, Device Trust, Secret-less Auth)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,800,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,642,651 to $35,415,933, a 6.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 79 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
